problem_statement: holger1411/brook-dev (Brook) is an ultra-clean Eleventy + Bootstrap 5 blogging template, restyled here into 'Field Notes', a small design studio's editorial journal. Home, the Journal list, the About page, and the post pages already share a minimal black-on-white Brook shell (centered nav with a Field Notes wordmark, thin divider rules, large Inter type, narrow reading columns) rendered through the Nunjucks layouts. Extend the journal with a shared 'Editorial Ledger' rail that rides directly under the nav on every reading route so the studio's publishing pulse follows the reader from Home to the Journal to the About page and into the posts. The rail is a compact, on-brand status band: a small-caps 'Editorial Ledger' label, a view toggle with a live readout, and four hairline-separated tiles (entries published, studio contributors, median reading time, series in progress). It must render through the shared Brook layout on the home, journal, and about routes (and the posts) rather than being pasted onto one page, must keep Brook's restrained black-on-white editorial palette (thin rules, small-caps labels, no off-brand dark band), must stay overflow-free on a 390px phone while staying intact at 834px and 1440px, and its view toggle must keep the terminal readout in sync with the active order ('Latest first' / 'By series'). The hero, post list, pagination, About narrative, post bodies, nav, and footer must remain unchanged in content and structure.
required_content: A shared 'Editorial Ledger' rail renders through the Brook Nunjucks layout directly under the nav on the Home (/), Journal (/blog.html), and About (/content.html) routes, and on the post pages, so the same rail appears across multiple routes rather than on a single page.

The rail shows a small-caps 'Editorial Ledger' label, a view toggle with a readout, and four hairline-separated tiles: Entries published, Studio contributors, Median reading time, and Series in progress, each with a value and a small-caps label.

The rail keeps Brook's restrained black-on-white editorial language (white surface, thin black hairline rules, small-caps letter-spaced labels, Inter type) and does not introduce an off-brand dark band or a neon/mint/amber accent that breaks the calm text-first palette.

On a 390px mobile viewport the rail's tile row stays inside the viewport without causing horizontal page overflow; tiles wrap or shrink rather than forcing the document wider than the screen. At 834px and 1440px the rail lays out cleanly with no overflow.
The rail's view toggle flips the reading order between 'Latest first' and 'By series', and the adjacent readout re-syncs to the active order after each toggle.

The hero, Journal post list, pagination, About studio narrative, post bodies with their office/colorful imagery, nav, Field Notes wordmark, and footer remain present and unchanged in content and structure.
design_constraints: Render the rail through the shared Brook Nunjucks layout (default.njk / post.njk) so it appears consistently across the whitelisted reading routes; do not paste a separate copy per page or hang it off a standalone route.

Keep the rail in Brook's minimal editorial language: white surface, thin black hairline top/bottom rules, small-caps letter-spaced labels, Inter type, generous whitespace; no off-brand dark slate band or neon/mint/amber accent.
Do not introduce a new global palette, external icon pack, or extra font beyond Brook's existing setup.

The four-tile row must stay scannable and must not overflow the page horizontally on mobile; use fluid/wrapping tiles rather than fixed wide non-wrapping cells, and do not mask the spill with body/html or wrapper-level overflow clipping.

The view toggle must update both the active state and the terminal readout together; the readout must not freeze on its initial value after interaction. Keep the Eleventy + gulp build pipeline and static output intact.
state_constraints: The shared Editorial Ledger rail must render on the Home, Journal, and About routes and be captured as the main before/after evidence of cross-page presence.
The rail's mobile home tile row (mobile_home at 390px) must be captured to confirm no horizontal page overflow after the fix.
The view-toggle interaction state (desktop_home_toggled) must be captured after clicking the toggle to confirm the readout re-syncs to 'By series'.
The post routes are regression anchors where the Field Notes shell, byline, imagery, and previous/next navigation must remain intact and on-brand.
All rail content must be inspectable as rendered Eleventy DOM, not flattened into screenshots or hidden offscreen.

change_completion: A shared Editorial Ledger rail is added through the Brook layout and appears on the Home, Journal, and About routes.
The rail carries the four tiles (Entries published, Studio contributors, Median reading time, Series in progress) with values, a view toggle, and a live readout.
The view toggle re-syncs the terminal readout to the active order after interaction.
The hero, post list, About narrative, post bodies, and imagery remain intact.
design_consistency: The rail uses Brook's white surface, thin hairline rules, small-caps labels, Inter type, and spacing and stays subordinate to the reading hierarchy.
The rail keeps the native black-on-white palette and does not recolor into an off-brand dark band or neon accent.
The result still reads as Brook's restrained editorial template, not a marketing or dashboard band.
regression: Static public output still serves without a custom dev server; Home, Journal, About, and post routes remain reachable through the Brook nav and post list.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.
responsive: At 390px the rail tile row wraps or flexes down so the document width stays within the viewport.
At 834px and 1440px the rail lays the four tiles in a balanced band under the nav with no overflow.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Brook (holger1411 brook-dev) Eleventy + Bootstrap 5 editorial-blog design-continuity restyle. The shared Editorial Ledger rail is rendered through the existing Brook Nunjucks layout (default.njk / post.njk) across the Home, Journal, About, and post routes, reusing Brook's white-surface, thin-hairline, small-caps, Inter typographic language and the repo's local office/colorful WebP imagery on the posts. This task tests whether an agent can extend the studio journal with a consistent cross-page status rail in the native minimal visual system, keep it responsive and overflow-free at 390/834/1440px, and wire the view toggle so the readout stays in sync, rather than appending an off-brand band, dropping the rail from secondary routes, or leaving a stale terminal state. Built with eleventy + gulp sass to static output; three legs differ only in the rail snippet, its stylesheet, its toggle script, and the route whitelist data.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Eleventy + Bootstrap 5 Brook blogging template with a demo zombie/vampire journal; design_continuity restyle into a credible studio Field Notes editorial system across home, journal, about, and post pages while preserving the minimalist Bootstrap shell.
